question: Why are defective ritual agents excluded?
premises: Because action is never greater than the completeness of the agent.
In the Devi Yamala scripture there is avoidance of Kanci and the like.
inference: A defective ritual agent cannot be compensated by ritual action, so scriptural exclusions remain valid.
uncertainties: The exact relation between the avoidance of Kanci and the exclusion of one-eyed teachers is not fully clear.
The compound kārakasāmagryātkarmaṇo allows more than one syntactic reading.
plain_english: Because action is nowhere greater than the completeness of the agent; and in the Devi Yamala scripture there is avoidance of Kanci and similar places.
